about: Draft VC3D plugin manifest for Ink Lens, written before VC3D had a plugin host (20 Oct 2026). The entry VC3D's plugin host reads (schema vc3d-plugin/1, the vc3d-plugins lane of the combined VC3D suite) is integrations/vc3d/plugins/scrolls.ink-lens.json, made from the tool registry's manifest kit/data/registry/ink-lens.json; it runs Ink Lens locally with downloads off and writes only into its run folder (--out). This file keeps the command-line contract of the bridge route (inklens.py run --from-vc3d --bridge).
name: Ink Lens
summary: A control-checked ink map of the region around the cursor, with letter-candidate pins. Model output, not a reading.

actions.title: Ink Lens: region at cursor

exit_codes.0: ink or weak: overlay and pins written
exit_codes.3: none or too_small: overlay written, empty
exit_codes.2: refused: nothing written, message on stderr

after: reload the segment's ink detections (VC3D has no bridge method for it yet)
the pins are already merged into the current point collections through the bridge
